criteria.label: Adoption
criteria.desc: Reach and real usage: users, customers, how often it is cited in developer and business surveys.

criteria.label: Autonomy
criteria.desc: How far it gets on a multi-step task without help.

criteria.label: Reliability
criteria.desc: Quality of results and stability on real work.

criteria.label: Security & governance
criteria.desc: Permissions, admin controls, audit and compliance options.

criteria.label: Integrations
criteria.desc: Connectors, app catalog, APIs and developer ecosystem.

criteria.label: Ease of access
criteria.desc: Free tier, entry price and effort to start.

criteria.label: Pricing transparency
criteria.desc: Prices public and itemized on the vendor page. Neutral (3) when we could not verify the page.

criteria.label: Momentum
criteria.desc: Pace of releases and growth in 2026.

agents.name: ChatGPT Agent
agents.what: Browses, runs code and works with files from one prompt, inside the most used AI app.
agents.pricing: Plus $20/mo; Pro from $100/mo
agents.why: Top on reach and access: it sits inside the most used AI app, with public plan prices.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.what: Terminal-native coding agent with a permission-gated execution loop.
agents.pricing: Pro $20/mo ($17 billed annually); Max $100/mo; Ultra $200/mo
agents.why: Highest autonomy among coding tools, with permission gates and public pricing; momentum is strong.

agents.name: Gemini (Deep Research, Agent Mode)
agents.what: Cited deep research and agentic browsing tied into Google Workspace.
agents.pricing: Free tier; AI Plus $4.99/mo; AI Pro $19.99/mo; AI Ultra from $99.99/mo. Agent Mode is named only for Ultra
agents.why: Huge reach and a free tier, but agent mode is named only for the top plan, so autonomy is capped.

agents.name: GitHub Copilot (coding agent)
agents.what: Cloud coding agent and code review, the safest enterprise default for many teams.
agents.pricing: Pro $10/mo; Pro+ $39/mo; Max $100/mo; Business $19/seat; Enterprise $39/seat. Coding agent on paid plans
agents.why: Best governance and reliability score among coding agents for teams; public per-seat pricing.

agents.name: OpenAI Codex
agents.what: Delegates coding tasks to cloud and local agents inside ChatGPT plans.
agents.pricing: Included in Plus $20/mo; Pro from $100/mo; Business $20/user/mo billed annually
agents.why: Strong autonomy and momentum, bundled into plans many teams already pay for.

agents.name: Claude (app, agentic tasks)
agents.what: Long-running work on files, documents and code with tool use.
agents.pricing: Free; Pro $20/mo; Max $100/mo; Team from $20/seat/mo billed annually
agents.why: Balanced across criteria; long-running file and code work with a free tier and clear plans.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.what: AI-first IDE with a multi-file agent; the most cited daily driver for developers.
agents.pricing: Free; Plus $8/mo; Premium $30/mo; Super $100/mo; Ultra $200/mo; Teams from $30/user
agents.why: Strong daily-driver for developers; governance is the weak spot, and plans have been renamed recently.
agents.note: The Plus tier includes Grok models only.

agents.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
agents.what: Agents inside Word, Excel, Teams and Outlook; Researcher and Analyst are pre-built.
agents.pricing: Copilot Business add-on $21/user/mo ($18 promo through Dec 31, 2026, annual commitment)
agents.why: Top on governance and integrations inside Microsoft 365; access is limited to licensed organizations.

agents.name: Manus
agents.what: Autonomous multi-step agent often cited for end-to-end task completion.
agents.pricing: Credit-based plans at $20, $40 and $200 per month on monthly billing; about 17% off annually
agents.why: High autonomy for end-to-end tasks with public credit-based plans; weaker on governance.

agents.name: Perplexity (Comet)
agents.what: Research agent with structured citations, plus an agentic browser.
agents.pricing: Free; Pro $17/mo and Max $167/mo, both billed annually
agents.why: Best-in-class citations and easy access; fewer agent controls than the leaders, with clear public plans.

agents.name: Salesforce Agentforce
agents.what: Agents grounded in CRM data for sales, service and operations.
agents.pricing: $2 per conversation; Flex Credits $500 per 100k; employee add-ons $125/user/mo
agents.why: Strong governance and reliability on CRM data; access is limited to Salesforce customers.

agents.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
agents.what: Low-code builder for custom agents across Microsoft 365 and Power Platform.
agents.pricing: Pay-as-you-go $0.01 per credit; capacity pack $200/mo for 25,000 credits (annual billing)
agents.why: Excellent governance and integrations for building agents in Microsoft environments; metered pricing.

agents.name: Zapier Agents
agents.what: Agents on top of the widest app catalog in automation.
agents.pricing: Free 400 activities/mo; Pro $33.33/mo billed annually (1,500 activities)
agents.why: Widest app catalog and clear pricing; autonomy and momentum are moderate.

agents.name: Devin
agents.what: Autonomous software engineer that plans, codes, debugs and opens pull requests.
agents.pricing: Free; Pro $20/mo; Max $200/mo; Teams usage-based, $80/mo minimum
agents.why: Very autonomous software engineer; reliability and breadth are lower than the leaders.

agents.name: Google Antigravity
agents.what: Multi-agent development platform with parallel agents on Gemini models.
agents.pricing: Free for individuals; paid tiers are not itemized on the official page
agents.why: Interesting parallel-agent design, free for individuals; paid tiers are not itemized.

agents.name: Replit Agent
agents.what: Lets non-engineers ship deployed full-stack apps.
agents.pricing: Core $20/mo ($18 annual); Pro $100/mo ($90 annual)
agents.why: Lets non-engineers ship apps and has clear pricing; reliability and governance are middling.

agents.name: Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI Agent Builder
agents.what: Agents grounded in company data with multi-agent orchestration.
agents.pricing: Business $21/seat/mo; Standard/Plus $30/seat/mo
agents.why: Strong governance on company data; adoption and momentum are still catching up.

agents.name: Fin
agents.what: One of the most cited customer-support agents; priced per outcome.
agents.pricing: From $0.99 per outcome; no seats for the standalone product
agents.why: Reliable support agent with a transparent per-outcome price; narrow in scope.

agents.name: n8n
agents.what: Open-source workflow platform with agents; can be self-hosted.
agents.pricing: Cloud Starter €20/mo and Pro €50/mo billed annually; Community Edition free to self-host
agents.why: Open source and self-hostable with transparent pricing; autonomy and adoption are moderate.

agents.name: Grok
agents.what: Real-time access to X data, useful for markets and news.
agents.pricing: Plus, Premium (4x Plus usage) and Super (15x) tiers; the official page shows prices in local currency
agents.why: Unique real-time X data and public tiers; weaker on governance and integrations.

agents.name: ServiceNow AI Agents
agents.what: Agents for IT and HR workflows in large companies.
agents.pricing: No public prices; quote or demo only
agents.why: Reliable and well governed for IT and HR; no public prices and access is via sales only.

agents.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
agents.what: Runs and governs agents inside AWS.
agents.pricing: Usage-based: Runtime $0.0895 per vCPU-hour; Gateway $0.005 per 1,000 calls; up to $200 credits for new AWS customers
agents.why: Strong governance on AWS with fully published unit prices; adoption is still developing.

agents.name: UiPath AI Agents
agents.what: RPA plus agents for companies that already automate with UiPath.
agents.pricing: Community free; Basic from $25/mo; Standard and Enterprise on request
agents.why: Reliable, governed automation for existing UiPath customers; enterprise tiers are on request.

agents.name: Glean
agents.what: Search and agents across all of a company's apps.
agents.pricing: No public prices; quote or demo only
agents.why: Excellent integrations and governance; no public prices and access is via a demo.
